fun_facts: Jared Curtis is from Nashville, Tennessee, and now plays for Vanderbilt, his hometown team.
As a junior at Nashville Christian, he threw for 2,830 yards and 40 touchdowns with just three interceptions, helping his team win Tennessee’s Division II-A state championship.
He also ran for 1,661 yards and 38 touchdowns during his high-school career.
In his final high-school game, he helped Nashville Christian win a second straight Division II-A title, throwing for 205 yards and five touchdowns and adding a rushing score.
Against Delaware in college, he threw for 210 yards and his first college passing touchdown, then ran for two more scores.
